name: Predict next frame
description: Create the next animation frame from the current frame. The current frame is sent as an image-to-image reference so the pose, palette, background, and canvas stay consistent with the sequence.

action.description: The motion to advance, e.g. 'walk forward one step'. Keep it a small increment.

transparent.description: Match the source frame's real alpha background by default; set true for a no-background frame or false for an opaque scene.
